About the Club

The Basketball Club was founded to bring students together through teamwork, sportsmanship, and growth.
Our mission is to make basketball accessible and enjoyable for everyone — no matter your experience level.
We believe in learning, fitness, and community through play.

What We Do:

We host weekly practices, friendly matches, skills workshops, and fun social meetups.
Whether you play casually or want to challenge yourself, there’s always a place for you here.

Team:

Meet the people who make The Basketball Club possible:
1. Coaches: Offer guidance and feedback to help you improve.
2. Organizers: Plan training schedules, reserve courts, and coordinate events.
3. Core Members: Support new players, lead warm-ups, and build a welcoming community.

Events

The Basketball Club organizes exciting activities year-round.

Special Events:

3-on-3 Tournaments

Challenge yourself in friendly competition. Open to all levels, held mid-semester.

Shooting Workshops

Learn techniques to improve precision and focus.

Charity Games

For a good cause, no competitive pressure.

Weekly Events:

Skills Clinics (Mon)

Dribbling, teamwork, and passing practice.

Open Gym (Wed)

Free play with friends and classmates.

Team Scrimmage (Sat)

Build strategy and team spirit.

Training

We offer structured training programs to help all members grow their basketball skills
— no matter where they start.

Beginner

Learn basketball basics — dribbling, layups, and movement.

Intermediate

Develop teamwork, refine shooting and defense, and learn strategic play.

Advanced

Work on advanced drills and prepare for tournaments or competitive play.

Each level helps you grow both in skill and confidence.

Equipment

We make sure every member has what they need to play comfortably.

View Rental Options

Basketballs and cones for training

Jerseys and team shirts

Gear exchange system for second-hand shoes or uniforms
